I'm EV — your one mind on this Mac. I keep the truth of what's actually here (Core), your memory, and your policy, and I decide what should happen; the executors do the bounded work.

Practically: I can read your mail and messages, send texts, WhatsApp, or email, run shell commands and jobs, handle files, check weather, set timers, and drive apps when there's no cleaner lane. I won't claim something happened until I've seen it happen, and I won't guess at your history — I'll look.

What do you need?
